cream_only.prompt: put the cream cheese box in the basket

cream_pick.prompt: pick up the cream cheese box

butter_only.prompt: put the butter in the basket

design: Exploratory secondary analysis of all 48 already-generated futures, without norm or semantic filtering. Prior 27 video reviews and shortlist outcomes were known before this analysis; not preregistered or blinded.
primary_comparison: Cream versus butter instruction at identical state, action wording and seed: 24 paired comparisons, 8 within each of 3 states.
controls: Same target and seed, different action wording: 24 pairs. Pick and put are different requests, not equivalent paraphrases.
Same full prompt and state, different seed: 72 pairs. Shared candidates make these comparisons dependent.
metrics: Generated-slot latent RMSE excluding the observed anchor
Per-camera decoded RGB MAE on frames 1 through 8, descriptive only
Provisional first-approach target label and both-intended-target fraction with all pairs in denominator
review: Reuse explicitly recorded AI reviews with hashes; inspect every previously unreviewed video in all nine frames and both cameras. Preserve unclear labels. No policy outcomes are used; no new policy actions are executed.
analysis_unit: state; average repeated seeds and wordings within state, then average states equally; no inferential p-values from 24 dependent comparisons
stopping_rule: Analyze exactly this complete bank. No new acquisition, threshold changes, or retrospective modification of the previous E1 selection.
limits: One checkpoint, one task, three previously selected later states. Countertask instructions and short horizon. Pixel/latent differences do not establish semantic correctness, imagination-policy causality, or benchmark success. Human review remains pending.
